question: A student performs an experiment with a concave mirror and covers the lower half of the reflecting surface with an opaque black paper. How does this modification affect the image formed of a distant object?

options.B: The full image is formed but with reduced intensity.
options.C: The focal length of the mirror doubles.
options.D: The image becomes blurred and distorted.
